title: ROS 2 "frame does not exist" after ros2 bag play: /tf_static, transient_local and the QoS override, measured
excerpt: When late tf2 listeners and tf2_echo get /tf_static from ros2 bag play and when they don't: VOLATILE player QoS, playback already ended, --start-offset. Includes the override YAML, --loop and topic echo checks. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
